note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 operator manual TM 9-2350-261-10 (M113A2 family of vehicles, August 2005). It holds the M1064 self-propelled 120 mm mortar carrier as a tracked entry. The manual publishes the dimensions, the gross weight with full load, a maximum engine rating with no net basis, the ground clearance, the fording depth, an automatic hydraulic transmission, the track shoe count and the grouser state. It names no maker, so maker is unknown. It publishes no operating weight, no net power, no track shoe width and no track pitch, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
